mn39:14.5: ‘Previously I got into debt and applied myself to work, and my efforts proved successful.
mn39:14.6: I have paid off the original loan and have enough left over to support my partner.’
mn39:14.11: ‘Previously I was sick, suffering, gravely ill. I lost my appetite and was physically weak. But now I have recovered from that illness, and I have regained my appetite and my strength.’
mn39:14.16: ‘Previously I was imprisoned in a jail. But now I have been released from jail, safe and sound, with no loss of wealth.’
mn39:14.21: ‘Previously I was a bondservant. I was not my own master, but indentured to another, unable to go where I wished. But now I have been freed from servitude. I am my own master, not indentured to another, a freeman able to go where I wish.’
mn39:14.26: ‘Previously, with wealth and property, I was traveling along a desert road.
mn39:14.27: But now I have crossed over the desert, safe and sound, with no loss of wealth.’
